odot_crash_costs.title: Crash Costs for Highway Safety Analysis (ODOT crash cost update, with Historical ODOT Published Crash Costs)
odot_crash_costs.publisher: Ohio Department of Transportation, Office of Program Management (Safety), ECAT tools

hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.page: p. 1, Economic Unit Cost column (Year 2025); p. 2, Historical ODOT Published Crash Costs, Economic Unit Costs, 2025 row
rules: one cost per KABCO level, every location type
ODOT's published series is the economic unit cost (p. 2); the comprehensive (MUWE) costs on p. 1 are not used
U (injury, level not reported) unpriced; Ohio's layer always gives a KABCO level

statewide_rates.missing: ODOT's public pages give no statewide average crash rates by facility type that CrashIQ could apply, and the pack has no Ohio traffic counts (ODOT TIMS has AADT layers; not wired)

screening.state_method: ODOT prioritises the network with AASHTOWare Safety (HSM Part B) since 2024 and requires an HSM Part C analysis for HSIP applications (FHWA Ohio HSIP 2024 report; FHWA PDF, not saved)

min_years.missing: ODOT's HSIP application threshold counts crashes per year over three years (FHWA Ohio HSIP 2024 report, executive summary; FHWA PDF, not saved) but no minimum study period for a corridor study was found

spf_calibration.missing: Ohio SPFs live inside AASHTOWare Safety (agency login); no published calibration factors were found; not loaded (no SPF engine)
